preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns in the matrix must be between 1 and 100.
The number of ones to place in the matrix must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in return_value.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' or a valid n x n matrix.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or sum(int(x) for line in return_value.splitlines() for x in line.split()) == k
postconditions.description: The total number of ones in the matrix must equal k.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(return_value.splitlines()[i].split()[j] == return_value.splitlines()[j].split()[i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1))
postconditions.description: The matrix must be symmetrical with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(return_value.splitlines()[i] >= return_value.splitlines()[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1))
postconditions.description: The matrix must be lexicographically maximal.
